notes.semetey-1-2013:p0423:b003:l032: Kanykey turns to recounting her six-month neglect by the living Manas and subsequent siege. Retrospective self-deprecation, not widowhood in that scene or narrator charge of shamelessness. Primary Yudakhin бет: кара бет sense 1 disgraced/publicly humiliated; sense 2 historically disgraced/unfortunate widow or bereaved bride, with an example also used by a wife reproached by her husband; sense 3 shameless/dishonest. The senses overlap: bereaved/unfortunate rendering does not erase the self-abasing association of shame. No complexion interpretation. Render self-deprecating карабет as unfortunate and nearby бейтаалай as ill-fated; no hostile charge or widowhood yet. Primary Yudakhin бет: кара бет sense 1 disgraced/publicly humiliated; sense 2 historically disgraced/unfortunate widow or bereaved bride, with an example also used by a wife reproached by her husband; sense 3 shameless/dishonest. The senses overlap: bereaved/unfortunate rendering does not erase the self-abasing association of shame. No complexion interpretation.
